CREATE TABLE "public"."extractionJob" (
  "batchExtractionId" "uuid",
  "cancelRequestedAt" timestamptz(6),
  "complete" bool,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "diagnostics" jsonb,
  "executionStatus" text DEFAULT 'QUEUED' NOT NULL,
  "failure" jsonb,
  "finishedAt" timestamptz(6),
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "leaseExpiresAt" timestamptz(6),
  "leaseOwner" text,
  "leaseVersion" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "modelAttribution" jsonb,
  "projectContextId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "rediscover" bool,
  "resultPayload" jsonb,
  "retryDocument" bool,
  "retryOfId" "uuid",
  "retryRecordStartBlockIds" jsonb,
  "schemaRevisionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "sourceDocumentId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "sourceRepresentationRevisionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz(6),
  "strategy" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
